title: A Relative-Computability Theory of Self-Improving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.27381v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agents increasingly modify the procedures by which they solve tasks and improve themselves. Autonomy over improvement, gains in practical capability, and enlargement of computational reach are distinct properties. We develop an oracle-relative model with mutable solvers, evaluators, and improvers. Uniform simulation keeps every total decision procedure produced by effective self-revision over $A$ within $\mathcal{C}(A)=\{D:D\leq_T A\}$; oracle joins account for additional access, while the relativized limit lemma separates limiting answers from effective completion. A worked model of Boolean rule acquisition makes the distinction constructive. For a known finite-dimensional feature language, we characterize exactly which answers a query history determines, obtain a sharp teacher-query bound, and give a terminating protocol that permits revisions to the query proposer. translated_title: 自改进智能体的相对可计算性理论
translated_abstract: 智能体正日益频繁地修改其解决任务的流程并进行自我改进。对改进的自主性、实践能力的提升以及计算范围的扩大是三种截然不同的属性。我们开发了一个相对于谕示的模型，其中包含可变的求解器、评估器和改进器。一致模拟保证了由针对 A 的有效自我修订所产生的每一个全判定程序都保持在 C(A)={D:D≤_T A} 之内；谕示连接用于刻画额外的访问能力，而相对化极限引理则将极限答案与有效完成区分开来。一个布尔规则获取的工作模型使这一区分具有构造性。对于一个已知的有限维特征语言，我们精确刻画了查询历史能够确定哪些答案，得到了一个紧致的教师查询上界，并给出了一个允许对查询提出者进行修订的可终止协议。所学的求解器可以在每一个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文建立了一个相对于谕示的可计算性理论，证明自改进智能体通过有效自我修订产生的任何判定程序都无法超越其谕示可计算范围 C(A)，并通过布尔规则获取模型构造性地区分了改进自主性、能力提升与计算范围扩大这三种属性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an oracle-relative computability theory proving that any total decision procedure produced by effective self-revision of a self-improving agent remains within the oracle-computable class C(A), and constructively distinguishes autonomy over improvement, capability gains, and expansion of computational reach through a Boolean rule acquisition model.
